title: Rabbi Abba Kifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:10, before Rabbi Yonah. Hyman reports that Korban HaEdah explains that Rabbi Abba said, “Bend the thigh,” while Penei Moshe reads it as Rabbi Abba from Kifa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The two commentaries disagree over whether the wording is a command to bend or a place-based byname.

The checked Sukkah 3:10 has the difficult phrase [Rabbi A]bba kifa. Penei Moshe explicitly reads Rabbi Abba from Kifa. The returned Korban HaEdah comment discusses closing the mouth and alternative readings involving speaking before someone; it does not match Hyman’s reported “bend the thigh” wording. That wording remains Hyman’s attributed report, and the existing mixed note remains verbatim.
